question: What is meant by sufficient appropriate audit evidence under SA 500? Explain the factors that affect its reliability.

points.label: Sufficiency
points.description: Sufficiency is the measure of the quantity of evidence; it depends on the assessed risk of material misstatement and the quality of the evidence.

points.label: Appropriateness
points.description: Appropriateness is the measure of the quality of evidence: its relevance and reliability.

points.label: Source of evidence
points.description: Evidence from independent sources outside the entity is more reliable; internally generated evidence is more reliable when related controls are effective.
points.basis: SA 500, reliability of audit evidence: source

points.label: Form of evidence
points.description: Evidence obtained directly by the auditor is more reliable than indirect evidence; documentary evidence is more reliable than oral; originals are more reliable than copies.
points.basis: SA 500, reliability of audit evidence: nature and form
